biggest_catch: Promo code GET250 must be entered at opening, and you need ten debit purchases plus $500 in qualifying electronic deposits within 60 days — note that Everwise's own internal transfers and your opening funding do not count.
catches: Promo code GET250 must be entered when opening — without it no bonus.
Within 60 days: enroll in eStatements, complete ten Debit Mastercard purchases, and receive qualifying electronic deposits totaling at least $500.
ACH from another bank, fintech, or digital wallet can qualify, but your opening funding, Everwise internal transfers, and isolated funding transactions do not.
Bonus is paid by the close of the next full statement cycle after requirements are met.
Excludes existing checking holders, anyone who closed a checking account in the prior 12 months, and anyone previously paid a new-checking bonus.
Applies to Simply, Plus, and Max checking accounts.
Terms effective July 1, 2025 and updated March 17, 2026; no stated expiration — can end at any time.
Indiana/Michigan membership rules apply; this is the former Teachers Credit Union (TCU), not Teachers Federal Credit Union.

Enroll in eStatements within 60 days of opening.
Make at least ten Debit Mastercard purchases within 60 days.
